$comment: The fixed evaluation set required by spec §11.1: 20 queries over three fictional PDFs,
in four categories (8 paraphrase, 4 denial, 4 condition, 4 no-answer).
It must be kept separate from any threshold-tuning examples.
Expectations name a passage by a distinctive snippet rather than by segment ID. Segment IDs
depend on the segmentation heuristics, so a frozen set keyed on them would silently break -
or silently pass against the wrong passage - the moment those heuristics are tuned. The
harness matches snippets with the same normalization exact search uses.
STATUS: the cases below are the worked examples from spec §1 and §13 only. The full 20-query
set cannot be authored until the fixture PDFs exist, because an expectation can only name a
passage a document actually contains. See tests/fixtures/README.md.

expect.snippet: distinctive text the intended passage contains (top3_contains)
expect.status: a status the search must not return (status_not)
